GMRAIRPORT.NS.d: GMR Airports Limited, formerly GMR Infrastructure Limited, develops and manages airports in India and abroad, under a model of building, owning, operating and transferring. It adopted the GMR Airports Infrastructure name in September 2022. The company was established in 1996 and is headquartered in New Delhi.

INDIANB.NS.d: Indian Bank provides various banking product and services. The company provides deposit products, including savings and current accounts, term deposits, and Non Resident Indian (NRI) accounts. It also offers agriculture, group, personal/individual, micro small and medium enterprises, education, and NRI loans.

INDIGRID-IV.NS.d: Indigrid Infrastruct Trst is an infrastructure investment trust (InvIT) in India, focused on owning, operating, and maintaining power transmission assets. It aims to provide stable and sustainable returns to its investors. The trust is based in Mumbai, India.

INDOBORAX.NS.d: Indo Borax & Chemicals Ltd. is an Indian producer and supplier of boron and lithium compounds, founded in 1980 and based in Mumbai. It makes borax decahydrate and granular borax, several grades of boric acid, and lithium hydroxide monohydrate.

JOCIL.NS.d: Jocil Limited manufactures and sells stearic acid flakes, fatty acids, soap noodles, toilet soaps, refined glycerine, and industrial oxygen in India. It operates through Chemicals, Soap, and Power segments. The company also offers contract manufacturing services; and generates power from biomass and wind. The company was formerly known as Jayalakshmi Oil and Chemical Industries Limited and changed its name to Jocil Limited in 1992. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Guntur, India.

LANCORHOL.NS.d: Lancor Holdings Limited and its subsidiaries build and develop residential and commercial real estate across India. They also lease commercial space, run related businesses and provide property maintenance. Founded in 1985 as DBS Properties Limited, the company is headquartered in Chennai.

LAURUSLABS.NS.d: Laurus Labs Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of medicines and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India and internationally. It operates through Generics APIs, Generics Finished Dosage Forms (FDF), and Synthesis segments.

MANAKCOAT.NS.d: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Limited manufactures and sells metal and household products in India and internationally. The company offers color coated pre painted galvanized steel, aluminum-zinc steel, and aluminum coils; and color coated (pre-painted) steel and aluminum sheets, as well as manufacture ultramarine blue powder used for improving whiteness of clothes and white washing/painting of walls.

MINALIND.NS.d: Minal Industries Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MINALIND and traded in INR. Its country is India.

MOKSH.NS.d: Moksh Ornaments Limited manufactures and wholesales jewellery across India. Its main offering is gold ornaments, for instance chains, bangles and mangalsutras in traditional designs. Founded in 2012, it runs its central operations from Mumbai.

NTPC.NS.d: NTPC Limited generates and sells bulk power to state power utilities in India. It operates in two segments, Generation of Energy and Others. The company generates power from coal, gas, liquid fuel, hydro, solar, nuclear, wind, thermal, and renewable energy sources. It also offers consultancy, project management, and supervision services. In addition, the company is involved in the energy trading, oil and gas exploration, and coal mining activities.

PATSPINLTD.NS.d: Patspin India Limited manufactures and sells combed cotton yarns in India. It offers yarns of various counts from NE 20's to NE 100's, as well as value added products. The company also exports its products. Patspin India Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.

PIIND.NS.d: PI Industries Limited manufactures and distributes agro chemicals in India, rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers agrochemicals, including insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides; specialty products; and generic molecules, such as Profenofos, Ethion, and Phorate primarily under the NOMINEE GOLD, OSHEEN, BIOVITA, COSKO, ROKET, KEEFUN, ELITE, HUMESOL, AWKIRA, Vibrant, Header, and COSKO SC brands, as well as chemical and active intermediates.

POLYCAB.NS.d: Polycab India Limited manufactures and sells wires and cables, and fast moving electrical goods in India and internationally. The company offers power, control, instrumentation, solar, flexible, flexible/single multi core, and communication cables, as well as building wires; and other cables, including welding cables, submersible flat and round cables, overhead conductors, rubber cables, green wires, railway signaling cables, and specialty cables.

SANATHAN.NS.d: Sanathan Textiles Limited, which works through subsidiaries, produces and distributes yarns globally to domestic and international customers. Established in Mumbai in 2005, it offers polyester filament yarns in many forms, including partially oriented, draw textured, recycled and melange types, as well as cotton yarns and high-performance yarns for technical textiles.

SHREEJISPG.NS.d: Shreeji Shipping Global Limited, founded in 1995 and based in Jamnagar, India, provides shipping and logistics for dry bulk cargo at ports and jetties across India and Sri Lanka. Its work spans lightering, stevedoring, port management and inland delivery from port to customer sites. It also charters vessels and rents out earthmoving equipment.

SOTL.NS.d: Savita Oil Technologies Limited manufactures and sells petroleum products in India. It operates through two segments, Petroleum Products and Wind Power. The company offers transformer oils, white oils, liquid paraffins, lubricating oils, petrolatum and petroleum jellies, cable filling compounds, and optic fiber compounds. It also offers waxes and wax derivatives, such as microcrystalline, polyethylene, and oxidized polyethylene waxes, as well as wax emulsions.

SUMIT.NS.d: Sumit Woods Limited engages in the real estate development activities in India. The company develops and sells residential, commercial, retail, and social infrastructure projects. Sumit Woods Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

SURYODAY.NS.d: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Limited operates as a small finance bank primarily serving the unserved and underserved with a focus on financial inclusion in India. The company operates through Treasury, Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company accepts savings and current accounts, term and fixed deposits, recurring deposits, and certificates of deposit.

UTIAMC.NS.d: UTI Asset Management Company Limited is an investment management firm that manages mutual funds for its clients. Established in Mumbai on 14 November 2002, it allocates capital across India's public equity, fixed income and money market sectors, guided by its own in-house research.

ZODIAC.NS.d: Zodiac Energy Limited, founded in 1992 and based in Ahmedabad, India, develops and installs power generation facilities and components across the country. Its solar offerings include grid-connected, rooftop, off-grid, solar pumping and building-integrated PV systems, along with solar water heaters for homes and businesses. It also provides EPC services for generator sets.
